completed_stage_receipts.summary: Classified user-facing version namespace ambiguity as a real observability defect; the user's date/SVN suggestion remained a candidate mechanism pending independent assessment.
One understandable revision must be shown without replacing Git SHA, protocol version, controller revision or owner/task state version.
Mapped receipt display, persisted timestamps, monotonic owner/task version, Git identity, protocol compatibility, controller trace, resume behavior, cross-owner adoption and performance.
First-observed namespace-leakage issue; no prior accepted human-revision repair to escalate from.
Studied SVN monotonic revisions, Git tag/describe semantics and CalVer; rejected emulating a centralized global counter across Git repositories.
Reuse authoritative updated_at plus existing monotonic manifest/owner version; no counter service, registry, tag stream or history traversal.
Rejected daily counter, tag-every-commit and SHA-only display; accepted derived <scope>-YYYYMMDD-rN with focused counterexamples.
No user architecture decision required; human revision is derived presentation only.
Existing progress/version authorities own the feature; no account instruction, protocol bump, root policy or ENTRYPOINT expansion.
O(1) derivation from already-loaded metadata; no new remote read, counter, registry or startup preload.
No revision registry and no per-checkpoint Git tags; technical namespaces remain authoritative and the new label is presentation-only.

Implemented Universal pilot UC-YYYYMMDD-rN. First M8 found two process regressions unrelated to the formatting algorithm: missing controller prepatch_checkpoint binding and deletion of the protected handoff anchor '当前模型不是 PR-first'. Reopened to M7, restored both, and retained the accepted version design unchanged.
